agent.commissionTermsAndConditions01: Commission Distribution Period: Between the 1st and 10th of each month, all commissions will be directly credited to the agent’s account by the system. No transaction record is required, and funds can be withdrawn immediately.
agent.commissionTermsAndConditions02: To settle commission payments, agents must have at least five valid active members each month. A player is considered active if their monthly deposit is ≥500 and their transaction volume is ≥1000.
agent.commissionTermsAndConditions03: Agents must recruit at least three new active members each month through promotion. If this requirement is not met, the activity will be regarded as zero promotion. The commission department reserves the right to reduce or deduct commissions. If fewer than ten new active members are recruited over three consecutive months, the agent account will be suspended and must contact platform support to reopen.
